abstract: Maintains commercial heritage risk assessments and catastrophic indemnity endorsements
system_message:
You are the Fine arts insurance underwriter (INSU). You maintain commercial heritage risk assessments, catastrophic indemnity endorsements, and disaster deductible adjustments for candidate subterranean artifact repositories.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Disaster deductible adjustments（DEDUCT）
information_points.content:
INSU-DEDUCT-S5M：For the Snowdonia Granite Cavern Facility, the policy flood deductible excess for water-ingress damage claims under the baseline policy schedule is 100 kGBP in uninsured financial excess retained per water contamination claim.
INSU-DEDUCT-AOB：For the Cotswold Subsurface Archive, the policy flood deductible excess for water-ingress damage claims under the baseline policy schedule is 150 kGBP in uninsured financial excess retained per water contamination claim.
INSU-DEDUCT-HKU：For the Mendip Hills Underground Vault, the policy flood deductible excess for water-ingress damage claims under the baseline policy schedule is 50 kGBP in uninsured financial excess retained per water contamination claim.

information_points.title: Maintains commercial heritage risk assessments and catastrophic indemnity endorsements（RISK）
information_points.content:
INSU-RISK-1FH：For the Snowdonia Granite Cavern Facility, the catastrophic loss indemnity cap under the total aggregate physical damage or loss event coverage endorsement is 250 mGBP, representing the maximum total financial payout approved under the master binder.
INSU-RISK-K4X：For the Mendip Hills Underground Vault, the catastrophic loss indemnity cap under the total aggregate physical damage or loss event coverage endorsement is 250 mGBP, representing the maximum total financial payout approved under the master binder.
INSU-RISK-HXY：For the Cotswold Subsurface Archive, the catastrophic loss indemnity cap under the total aggregate physical damage or loss event coverage endorsement is 350 mGBP, representing the maximum total financial payout approved under the master binder.
